subject.title: [Feature]: /learn command — distill recent work into a reviewable skill draft

question: Should OpenClaw reserve `/learn` as a built-in core command for drafting Skill Workshop proposals from recent work?
rationale: The request fits Skill Workshop ergonomics, but it adds a new cross-channel core command and sits near the VISION.md boundary between lean core, plugins, skills, and ClawHub packaging.

options.title: Approve thin core command
options.body: Land the linked PR after blockers are fixed, preserving the existing Skill Workshop proposal, scanner, and human approval gates.

options.title: Keep existing workflow
options.body: Do not add a core command; improve docs/help around asking the agent or using CLI Skill Workshop proposals instead.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Require this affordance to live as a plugin, skill, or ClawHub package if maintainers do not want another built-in command.

recommendation.title: Approve thin core command
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after blockers are fixed, preserving the existing Skill Workshop proposal, scanner, and human approval gates.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent command registry and Skill Workshop history and authored the protected product request plus linked implementation PR.
